settings.heading: Furniture that fits how you actually live
One chair, five years of prototypes
settings.lead: Our founding designer spent five years refining a single steam-bent oak frame before it ever went into production — testing joinery, seat pitch and linen weight until the chair felt as good after a decade of use as it did on day one.
settings.body: Every Oak Lounge Chair is built from FSC-certified European oak, upholstered in undyed heavyweight linen over a webbed jute seat, and finished entirely by hand in our partner workshop.

settings.heading: Slow furniture, made by hand
settings.lead: Every Ardea piece passes through the hands of fewer than twelve people, from the timber yard to your living room. We work with small, family-run workshops rather than mass factories, because joinery this precise can't be rushed.

settings.title: Exactly as described, and then some
settings.body: The Oak Lounge Chair is the first piece of furniture we've bought that feels like it was actually built by someone, not stamped out. The oil finish smell on arrival was lovely too.
settings.author: Priya M.

settings.title: Sofa arrived faster than expected
settings.body: Was ready for a long wait given it's made to order, but the sofa arrived in three weeks and the two-person delivery team was careful and quick.
settings.author: Rohit K.

settings.title: Beautiful grain, needs a coaster habit
settings.body: The walnut coffee table looks stunning in person — just make sure everyone in the house uses coasters, the live edge shows every ring if you don't.
settings.author: Ananya S.
